messages:
elaine: Heads up — I found a mismatch in the /generate API docs. The curl example shows precision: 85 (integer/percentage) but the SDK snippets send precision: 0.85 (float). Which canonical shape do we want? Need a short migration note and consistent examples across curl/python/ts.

mike: Good catch. Runtime currently accepts floats in 0.0-1.0 range. Older SDKs serialized ints for the examples we copied. I think standardizing on float fraction (0.0-1.0) is safest for future work.

jamie: Agree on fraction floats. Quick plan: update API ref and examples to use 0.85, add a small migration blurb for users who previously sent 85.

elaine: I'll open a docs PR with curl/python/ts examples + a migration section showing how to convert percentage -> fraction. Also will add a note in the example call about allowed range (0.0-1.0).

mike: Note: OpenAPI currently lists precision as integer in schemas. I'll file a schema change to number (float) so generated clients reflect it. Will check backwards compat and client codegen implications.

sarah: If we change schema, we need to regenerate SDKs or at least ship a patch. @devex please advise on timeline for JS/Go/py.

jamie: Devex update: we can ship a small patch for JS/Go in one day after schema change; Python client needs a release cycle but we can include a snippet in docs in the meantime that does float(value)/100 conversion.

elaine: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — includes updated examples, migration note, and a tiny code snippet for conversion. PTAL :eyes: (I added a short test file for the example harness too).

mike: Left a couple inline comments asking to show both the curl and the SDK JSON payloads side-by-side, and to add a unit check to the examples harness asserting precision <= 1.0. Also suggested a one-line note: "accepts ints for backward compatibility but prefer float fraction".

jamie: I'll follow up to update SDK snippet formats post-merge. Also recommend adding a tiny example showing percentage-to-fraction conversion: Python and TS one-liners.

elaine: Added conversion snippet in PR: `precision = max(0.0, min(1.0, value / 100.0))` (python) and `const precision = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value / 100));` (ts). Also updated the example harness test.


docs-bot: docs-bot: PR 1234 deployed to staging preview -> https://deploy-preview-1234--docs.redwood.ai. Visual check: examples show 0.85 in all snippets.

mike: I'll open the OpenAPI schema PR once docs folks confirm wording. Leaving LGTM pending the harness tests passing.

elaine: Thanks — I'll address your comments this afternoon and ping the thread. If tests pass, plan to merge tomorrow morning.

jamie: Sounds good, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
